node.statement: Starting from the root supplied MAIN partition state for the same A,w, retain J,A,w, the atomic images P_k, the relation, and its class family, and set the current nonempty subset field to this U and the reset-state-reference field to the exact state of node 1.3.1.1. This is a supplied MAIN partition state by def-maincb-partition-state: the definition permits any current nonempty subset of J and a reference to one separately supplied reset state. Its current subset/reference is therefore exactly U,v_U, while all geometric data remain those of the root state.
